  let raw := rawActionPrefix246 state bit

theorem rawActionPrefix246_target_bounded : ∀ (q : Fin 246) (b : Bool),

/-- All 246 old working labels, in canonical order. -/
def oldLabelsPrefix246 : Array Nat := #[

            start = int(line.split()[-1])
